title: Welcome — Let's Build It Together

story_structure.value: A two-part build declared in the script doc itself: L1–L7 carried verbatim from v2 (identity → the AGI reframe → capability: files and file systems → method: videos built together, one step at a time), then the closing section Hadi asked for on 2026-10-22 (L8–L11): the self-proof — this video is an example, an agent made it from files, nothing about its making is hidden — resolving into the invitation (L10: take it, give it to your agent, make your own) and the cover close ('LET'S BUILD IT TOGETHER.', 1.2 s hold). The video proves its own promise; that is the structure's engine, recorded as the piece's concept in the element audit.
story_structure.rationale: Structure is decided in the script doc's intro and production notes — the only place it could be: the piece predates the Section N narrative-declaration form (the board logs its Narrative Gate item 'na — predates Section N (v2.7)'), so no N-04/N-06 declaration exists and none is invented here. The v1→v2 and v2→v3 critique rounds are logged in the script docs' headers (v2: Hadi's direction — calmer, simple and inviting, no pushing; v3: the closing section added at Hadi's 2026-10-22 ask).
story_structure.source: hadi direction (closing section, 2026-10-22) + archer reasoning (script doc intro + production notes)

hook_form.value: Identification opening — no curiosity hook, by design: L1 names the channel and its promise in the title's own words ('Welcome. This is Let's Build It Together.'), because the piece IS the channel trailer: a viewer arriving from any short meets the channel's name and its promise in the opening itself. The click record (annex A2, a labeled RECONSTRUCTION) reads the title the same way: 'the title's job is identification, not curiosity'.
hook_form.rationale: Carried decided on the strength of the element audit, which counts the title element rationale-found via the annex's DR-1 reconstruction — with the reconstruction's own caveat quoted verbatim, as the annex states it: 'If this reading is wrong, the element returns to random — it is a reconstruction, not a recovered intention.' No DR-1 was written at build time (the piece predates the DR-1 requirement); nothing stronger is claimed here.
hook_form.source: archer reasoning (Job Q2 reconstruction, 2026-10-23 — labeled as such in its source)
hook_form.record: files/short-intro-v3-context-annex.md — §A2 (DR-1 click record, RECONSTRUCTION, labeled); hidden_files/context-audit-2026-10-23/audit.json — pieces[intro-v3] title element (rationale found, q2_filled 2026-10-23 Job Q2)
